description: Community device reports for the leaderboard on benchmarks.html: one record per issue labelled device-report, keyed by the issue number. Generated from the issues by .github/workflows/ingest-reports.yml (tools/ingest/ingest.py); edit the issue, not this file.

fields.fps: Game fps, the frames the game itself renders, as reported. From the tools/bench row when the report has one, else parsed from the report's Results.
fields.p50_ms, p99_ms: Median and 99th percentile frame time in ms, or null when not reported.
fields.baseline: The figure the report compares with (for example the build without a switch), or null.
fields.scene_ok: true only when the numbers come from a tools/bench row that is valid and passed its scene check against the tester's reference screenshot; null otherwise.
fields.gpu_vendor, gpu_type: intel, amd, nvidia or other; integrated, discrete or unknown, from the form's Graphics card answer.
fields.runs: Every valid tools/bench row of the report (variant, scene, fps, p50_ms, p99_ms, switches).
fields.notes: Caveats a reader should see next to the numbers.
